meta.title: Tailscale remote access
meta.description: Publishes the DSH Web GUI on your tailnet whenever DSH runs, so a phone anywhere can connect, and removes the route on exit. Your login link lives in the loginUrl field of ~/.dsh/tailscale-remote.json (https://<machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net:7259/remote/<key>); bookmark it once on the phone — it survives restarts.
